crossRefs.note: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of…
Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up Yahweh’s ark.
So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.
translations.bsb: The next morning the Israelites set out and camped near Gibeah.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
